reel.leadA: No German future without this verb ⏭️
reel.exTrans: = He’s becoming a doctor. (ich werde · du wirst · er wird)

caption:
„werden“ is a German power verb 🔑
It means „to become“ — AND it builds the future and the passive. One verb, three jobs.
Er wird Arzt. = He’s becoming a doctor.
